subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Runtime helper objects grouped by the generic_runtime_objects scope: an MPEG media-stream decoder with I/O interface, header state machine and output-buffer fill (0x0052Dxxx-0x0052E3xx), a DEFLATE/zlib-style codec family (inflate state machine 0x00537110, bitstream encoder 0x00537F30/0x00537FE0, compression-buffer pipeline 0x00536160, codec state/callback manager 0x00537000/0x00537070/0x00537CE0), a stream-decoder object with audio/texture-palette modes (0x0051A968, 0x0051D166), object lifecycle helpers (partial reset 0x00511F70, dispatch-table object init 0x00516883, resource-state reset 0x00517963, virtual cleanup 0x0052D990), a UI-element-style reset (0x00535E10), and free-form helpers (calloc allocator 0x00513D3D, delegation wrappers 0x0052803A/0x00536FD0/0x005357C0, debug output 0x0052E4E0, big-endian writer 0x00536130). All packet owners are UnknownObject/UNKNOWN; class groupings and names are DERIVED/GUESS synthesis.

summary: Derived architecture proposal for 26 validated functions in scope generic_runtime_objects, all with packet-UNKNOWN owners. The largest defensible cluster is a GUESS MpegStreamDecoder class: the constructor 0x0052E170 stores two interface pointers at +0x2D34/+0x2D38 and installs the RenderObject vtable off_5B4810; DecodeHeader 0x0052DC90 reads a 4-byte sync word through the I/O interface vtable read slot at +8 of the interface at +0x2D34 and processes it via CMpegBase_ProcessHeader (0x0052DA30); MpegBufferFill 0x0052E350 fills the caller output buffer from the internal +0x1244 buffer using frame-size/residual fields (+0x249C/+0x24E8) and reports 'mpeg fail' strings; DeferredDeactivation 0x0052E320 clears the +0x24EC/+0x24F0 pending flag pair; ProcessHeaderFailed 0x0052DE40 and the arithmetic helper 0x0052E080 are thin callers-side helpers shared with the open paths 0x0052E090/0x0052E1D0. A second GUESS cluster is a DEFLATE codec family: InflateDecompressStateMachine 0x00537110 is a zlib-inflate state machine (states 0-9, BFINAL flag at +0x18, bit accumulator at +0x20, error diagnostics at 0x005DA8xx), BitstreamEncoder 0x00537F30/0x00537FE0 implements the matching deflate-side bit writer (shift register +0x16AB, bit count +0x16AD, capacity +0x16A7), CompressionBuffer 0x00536160 copies between source/destination ring sub-buffers, and CodecStateManager 0x00537000/0x00537070/0x00537CE0 performs state-machine reset with callback re-registration and multi-block allocation. The remaining objects (ResourceContainer partial reset, DispatchTableObject, ResourceStateManager, StreamDecoder audio/texture modes, VirtualObjectCleanup, UiElement reset, BigEndianWriter) and four free helpers are kept separate because their field regions and callees do not overlap. No cross-class field merging is asserted: equal offsets on different bases (obj+0x0, this+0x0) are mirrored, not merged.

function_roles.role: Partial reset of a large container: pre-processes two caller pointers through ShortComputation_3d2f, releases six unconditional sub-resources (this+0x9C/0xD8/0xDC/0x138/0x174/0x178) and flag-guarded resources (this+0x104 gated on byte+0x5D bit 0x10, this+0x15C gated on bit 0x20) through release callbacks, releases a counted pointer array (base this+0x144, 1 << (8 - byte+0x12C) elements), runs sub_5179A2 on the sub-object at this+0x100, zeroes 0x19C bytes while preserving the first 0x40 bytes and dwords at +0x40/+0x44/+0x48, and returns the preserved dword at +0x48

Calloc-style allocation helper: early-exits returning 0 when a1 is 0, otherwise requests an allocation via AllocAndZeroInit(2) (0x00517E43) and zeroes the first 0x40 bytes of the non-null result with memset before returning it; single recorded caller sub_50210E

Dispatch-table object initializer: clears the table pointer at this+0x4, calls StubReturning0 (0x0058FB7E) for the slot-11 entry, allocates an 80-byte table via MallocWrapper(a1, 80) (0x00519346), populates slots 0..10 with allocator/cache function pointers (0x00515F23..0x00516853), zeroes slots 13..17, records size 80 at slot 18; on allocation failure calls EmptyStub_7b96 (0x00587B96), writes error constant 53 to obj+0x14 and 0 to obj+0x18, and dispatches the error handler through the vtable at *a1

Resource-state reset with early-out guards: returns -2 when this or the sub-object pointer at this+0x1C is null; otherwise clears this+0x8/+0x14/+0x18, writes the sub-object first dword to 7 or 0 depending on the condition field at this+0x28, calls sub_52765A with the data pointer at this+0x30, this, and 0, and returns 0; called by sub_5179E0 and sub_519019

Audio decode-buffer reset: accumulates (decode state +20 at this+0x1A8)/8 into the output total at this+0x1E8 and clears the byte counter; invokes the output-buffer callback at *(this+0x190 + 8) with this; on truthy result and channel count this+0x120 > 0, zeroes the per-channel dword array at this+0x1B4 over this+0x120 entries, copies the reference this+0xFC into this+0x1C4, clears the ready byte at this+0x1AC and returns 1; otherwise returns the callback's falsy result

Stream-decoder sub-struct init: allocates a 48-byte decoder object through vtable entry 0 of the allocator interface at this+0x4, records it at this+0x19C, seeds its first function pointer with PhysicsObjectStateSetter (0x0051CD3E), clears its +0x8 byte, and computes the streaming-buffer size as this+0x5C times this+0x64 into +0x28; when the mode flag at this+0x110 equals 2 installs the audio path (AudioSampleStream 0x0051CD53 at +0x4, sub_51CF80 0x0051CF80 at +0xC) and allocates the streaming buffer through vtable entry 1 of this+0x4; otherwise installs the texture/palette path (VirtualDispatchWrapper_cdf9 0x0051CDF9, TexturePaletteColorLookup 0x0051CE2A) and leaves the buffer null; finishes via WheelGeometryDataInitialization
Thin __cdecl delegation wrapper: ignores its first argument a1 and forwards a2 and a3 to sub_58AB58, returning the callee's result unchanged

Guard-based virtual cleanup helper: reads the stored object pointer at this+0x0 and returns 0 if null; otherwise dispatches the object's first vtable entry with argument 1 (virtual destructor/deleter), clears this+0x0 to 0 and returns 1; used as the cleanup stage by object creators 0x00405440, 0x00405630 and ThreadedObjectCreatorWithSEH (0x0052D8D0)

DecodeHeader stage of an MPEG media player: when the header-read-needed flag at this+0x2D3C is set, reads a 4-byte sync word through the I/O interface read slot at vtable+8 of *(this+0x2D34), byte-swaps it, and hands it to CMpegBase_ProcessHeader (0x0052DA30); frame size below 4 or a short follow-up read into this+0x24A4 reports the corrupted-header string, clears this+0x24A8 and re-arms this+0x2D3C; failed reads report the waiting-for-CD string (0x005DA65C) and return -1

Thin wrapper around CMpegBase_ProcessHeader (0x0052DA30) that returns TRUE (1) when the callee returned -1 (parse/error) and FALSE (0) otherwise; called from CMpegBase_Open (0x0052E090) and CMpegFilePlayer_Open (0x0052E1D0)

Pure integer arithmetic helper: computes (__int64)a1 * a2 / a3 with a 64-bit intermediate and returns the int-truncated quotient; placed in the MPEG playback path via callers CMpegBase_Open and CMpegFilePlayer_Open

Render-object constructor: initializes the GameObject base via ObjectVTableInitialization (0x0052D9F0), stores caller-supplied interface pointers at this+0x2D34 and this+0x2D38, then overrides the vtable pointer at this+0x0 with the RenderObject vtable off_5B4810 and returns this; reached from ThreadedObjectCreatorWithSEH (0x0052D8D0)

Conditional deferred-deactivation helper: when the pending-deactivation flag byte at this+0x24EC is non-zero, clears the 32-bit sync word at this+0x24F0 and the flag byte to 0, then calls Return0Stub (0x0047ABB0) and EmptyStub_0170 (0x004B0170); always returns 0; existing analysis ties it to MPEG decoder re-initialization (DERIVED prose)

Output-buffer fill for decoded MPEG data: loops while fewer than a3 bytes are produced, tracking the byte residual at this+0x24E8 against the frame size at this+0x249C; on equality decodes a fresh frame into the caller output buffer via sub_52DF10, otherwise decodes into the internal buffer at this+0x1244 and copies the available residual out; decode failures report 'mpeg fail 1/2' strings (0x005DA700/0x005DA6F0) via FileOpWithGlobalBuffer and zero the failed region; finishes by recomputing the byte position at this+0x24B4 from this+0x248C/this+0x24E4/this+0x24E8 and returns the produced byte count; invoked by GuardedFunctionCall (0x0052D970)

printf-style debug output helper: formats the caller's arguments into a fixed 256-byte stack buffer via SafeStringFormat (0x0058AC95) and emits the result through OutputDebugStringA (0x0059E230); always returns 0

Thin forwarding wrapper that re-orders arguments and fixes the callee's second parameter to the constant 15: invokes sub_5356A0 with (a1, 15, a2, a3) and returns the callee's result; called by sub_59B260

Conditional multi-field reset on the frame path: returns -2 when this, the sub-object pointer at this+0x1C, or the guard pointers at this+0x20/this+0x24 are null; otherwise zeroes this+0x8/+0x14/+0x18, sets this+0x2C to 2 and this+0x30 to 1, resets sub-object fields (v1[5]=0, v1[4]=v1[2], v1[6] clamped to >=0, v1[1] set to 113 or 42 by v1[6], byte at v1+30 cleared), then calls UIElementInitialization (0x00537E40) and sub_536260 on the sub-object; invoked by sub_535C10

Big-endian short writer: writes the high byte then the low byte of a2 into the byte buffer stored at this+0x8 at a write offset stored at this+0x20, advancing the write offset by 2, and returns the advanced offset; called by sub_535E80

Buffer copy with size tracking in the compression/decompression pipeline: copies min(source remaining, destination remaining) bytes from the source sub-object (this+0x1C, with total at +0x8, read pointer at +0x10, remaining at +0x14) into the destination write pointer at this+0xC, advancing both pointers, decrementing both remainders, accumulating the total at this+0x14, and reloading the source remaining from its total when it reaches zero
Thin __fastcall delegation wrapper: ignores its first argument a1 (ECX) and forwards a2 and a3 to sub_58AB58, returning the callee's result unchanged

State-machine lifecycle reset that zeroes state slots, restores a saved backup value, and optionally re-registers a callback: optionally writes a1[15] into *a3; when the state code *a1 is 4 or 5 invokes the function pointer at a2+36 with (*(a2+40), a1[3]); state 6 calls IndirectCallViaVTable0x24(a1[1], a2); resets state to 0, restores the backup a1[10] into a1[12]/a1[13] (this+0x30), zeroes a1[7]/a1[8]; if the stored callback a1[14] is non-null calls it with (0,0,0) and stores the result into a1[15] and a2+48, returning it; used by 0x00535620, sub_5357E0, MultiBlockAllocator and TripleVTableCall

Fastcall factory for a multi-block allocator: calls the allocation callback at a1+32 with context *(a1+40) to obtain the header object v6, allocates an 8 x 1440-byte block array stored at v6[9] and a single a3-byte payload block at v6[10] (end address at v6[11]), records a2 at v6[14], zeroes the header word *v6, and calls StateResetWithCallback(v6, a1, 0) to finish; on any failure rolls back through the deallocation callback at a1+36 and returns 0

Core DEFLATE (zlib inflate) decompression state machine driven per-frame by sub_5357E0: switch over states 0-9 (jump tables 0x00537C9C/0x00537CC4) covering stored blocks (LEN/NLEN), fixed and dynamic Huffman, decode-table construction (0x00539F70, 0x0053A4D0, ObjectAllocFieldInit 0x00539830), symbol decode against mask table 0x005DBB90, output via AudioRingBufferCopy (0x0053A660), with error statuses -2/-3/-4 and diagnostics at 0x005DA914/0x005DA8F4/0x005DA8D0/0x005DA8B4; block state at this+0x0, BFINAL at this+0x18, bit accumulator this+0x20, ring limit pointer this+0x28, stream read pointer at obj+0x0

Triple vtable dispatch after reset: calls StateResetWithCallback(a1, a2, 0), then invokes the same function pointer stored at a2+36 three times with the object at a2+40 and the arguments a1[10] (this+0x28), a1[9] (this+0x24), and a1 itself; always returns 0

Bitstream accumulation write: ORs (a3 << bitCount) into the shift register at this+0x16AB and raises the bit count at this+0x16AD by 3; when bitCount exceeds 13, flushes the two-byte register to the output buffer (base this+0x8, offset this+0x14), advances the offset by 2, decrements bitCount by 13, and re-anchors the register to (uint16)a3 >> (16 - oldBitCount); always calls ChecksummedBufferWriter(a2, 1) (0x005397A0) and returns its result

End-of-block bitstream encode: ORs '2 << bitCount' into the shift register at this+0x16AB, accumulating or flushing a two-byte register to the output buffer (base this+0x8, offset this+0x14) by the 13-bit and 9-bit thresholds, re-anchoring the remaining bits; a capacity check on this+0x16A7 may force a second marker write and flush; completes by calling BitStreamWriter (0x00539690) and setting capacity this+0x16A7 to 7

classes.name: ResourceContainer
classes.responsibility: Large container whose partial reset (0x00511F70) releases six unconditional embedded sub-resources, two flag-guarded sub-resources (byte at +0x5D bits 0x10/0x20), and a counted pointer array (base +0x144, element count 1 << (8 - byte +0x12C)) through release callbacks, runs sub_5179A2 on the sub-object at +0x100, then zeroes 0x19C bytes while preserving the head (first 0x40 bytes plus dwords at +0x40/+0x44/+0x48).

Fields +0x24/+0x2C/+0x30/+0x38 are listed in the packet field facts but are not referenced by the raw body.

classes.name: CodecStateManager
classes.responsibility: Codec state/callback manager for the DEFLATE family: 0x00537000 resets the state machine (state code at +0x0, backup value at +0x28 restored to +0x30, slots +0x7/+0x8 zeroed) and re-registers the callback from a caller-owned slot layout (a2+36/+40/+48); 0x00537070 is a fastcall multi-block allocator factory that allocates an 8 x 1440-byte block array and a payload block through the allocator interface embedded in a1 and calls StateResetWithCallback(v6, a1, 0); 0x00537CE0 performs a triple dispatch through the same a2+36 slot after reset.

classes.name: DeflateInflater
classes.responsibility: DEFLATE (zlib inflate) decompression state machine (0x00537110) driven per-frame by sub_5357E0: switch over states 0-9 handling stored blocks, fixed/dynamic Huffman, decode-table construction and symbol decoding, with output via AudioRingBufferCopy and -2/-3/-4 error statuses carrying diagnostic strings. Block state at +0x0, BFINAL flag at +0x18, bit accumulator at +0x20, table parameter at +0x24, ring-buffer limit pointer at +0x28, stream read pointer at obj+0x0.

classes.name: BitstreamEncoder
classes.responsibility: DEFLATE-side bitstream encoder: 0x00537F30 accumulates three bits per call into the shift register at +0x16AB with bit count at +0x16AD and flushes a two-byte register to the output buffer (base +0x8, offset +0x14) past a 13-bit threshold; 0x00537FE0 appends an end-of-block marker and enforces a capacity check at +0x16A7. Both report through the checksummed buffer writer (0x005397A0) / bitstream writer (0x00539690).

state_machines.name: DeflateInflateStateMachine
states: state_0: stored-block header read (BFINAL/BTYPE bit accumulation, this+0x20)
state_1: stored LEN/NLEN validation (~LEN complement check)
state_2: stored byte copy bounded by ring-buffer availability (this+0x28)
state_3: Huffman header (HLIT/HDIST/HCLEN) and code-length table allocation
state_4: 3-bit code-length table build via sub_539F70
state_5: symbol decode against mask tables and literal/length-distance table build (sub_53A4D0)
state_6: output emission via IndirectCallViaVTable0x24 / AudioRingBufferCopy
state_7/8: flush/final (BFINAL at this+0x18 selects the final path)
state_9: error (invalid block type / stored length / too many lengths / invalid bit length)
transitions: dispatch on state code at this+0x0 via compiler jump tables 0x00537C9C/0x00537CC4
BTYPE 0 -> state 1 (stored), 1 -> state 6 after dynamic table allocation (0x0053A630, ObjectAllocFieldInit 0x00539830), 2 -> state 3 (fixed), 3 -> error state 9 (-3)
state 1 LEN/NLEN mismatch or state 3 HLIT/HDIST overrun or state 5 repeat overrun -> error state 9 with diagnostics and -3 via AudioRingBufferCopy
state 6 with BFINAL set -> state 7 (final); otherwise back to state 0

state_machines.name: CodecStateResetMachine
states: idle: state code 0 after reset (backup a1[10] at this+0x28 restored to this+0x30)
state_4/5: caller callback at a2+36 dispatched with (*(a2+40), a1[3])
state_6: vtable+0x24 dispatch via IndirectCallViaVTable0x24(a1[1], a2)
transitions: state code at *a1 (this+0x0) selects the optional pre-reset dispatch, then state is reset to 0
stored callback at a1[14] re-registered with (0,0,0); its result stored at a1[15] and a2+48
TripleVTableCall (0x00537CE0) drives three dispatches through the a2+36 slot after reset

state_machines.name: StreamDecoderModeMachine
states: mode_2: audio sample-stream path (AudioSampleStream 0x0051CD53 at sub-struct +0x4, sub_51CF80 0x0051CF80 at +0xC, streaming buffer allocated via allocator vtable entry 1 into +0x20)
other: texture/palette path (VirtualDispatchWrapper_cdf9 0x0051CDF9 at +0x4, TexturePaletteColorLookup 0x0051CE2A at +0xC, streaming buffer left null)
transitions: guard on mode flag at this+0x110: value 2 selects the audio path, every other value selects the texture/palette path
both paths share the 48-byte decoder sub-struct recorded at this+0x19C seeded with PhysicsObjectStateSetter at +0x0

state_machines.name: MpegHeaderReadMachine
states: header_pending: header-read-needed flag at this+0x2D3C set; 4-byte sync word not yet read
header_present: flag clear; frame-size validation active
corrupt: processed frame size below 4 or short raw read into this+0x24A4; frame-size field this+0x24A8 cleared and flag re-armed
transitions: set flag -> I/O virtual read of 4 bytes at vtable+8 of *(this+0x2D34), byteswap, CMpegBase_ProcessHeader (0x0052DA30)
read of other than 4 bytes -> waiting-for-CD report (0x005DA65C) and -1
short follow-up raw read -> corrupted-header report (0x005DA5FC), this+0x24A8 = 0, this+0x2D3C = 1

interfaces.name: IResourceRelease
interfaces.purpose: Generic sub-resource release callback: ResourceContainer partial reset (0x00511F70) releases six unconditional sub-resources and a counted pointer array through ConditionalCall_7ec8 (0x00517EC8) and a guarded release through SafeDeleteGuardForThunkFUN00517ec8 (0x00513CD3); the callback targets are caller-defined.

interfaces.name: IAllocatorInterface
interfaces.purpose: Vtable-based allocation interface reached at this+0x4: entry 0 allocates/initializes the 48-byte decoder sub-struct and entry 1 allocates the streaming buffer (0x0051D166); the same pattern backs the dispatch-table allocation (MallocWrapper 0x00519346 in 0x00516883), the calloc helper (AllocAndZeroInit 0x00517E43 in 0x00513D3D) and the multi-block allocator (0x00537070).

interfaces.name: IMpegIoInterface
interfaces.purpose: Byte I/O interface at this+0x2D34 whose read slot lives at vtable+8: the MPEG DecodeHeader stage reads the 4-byte sync word and the follow-up raw header bytes through it; the constructor stores the interface at +0x2D34 (primary) and +0x2D38 (secondary).

interfaces.name: ICallbackDispatcher
interfaces.purpose: Caller-owned callback slot layout (a2+36 function pointer, a2+40 object, a2+48 result slot, plus the state-object slots a1[14]/a1[15]) invoked by the codec state reset (0x00537000) and the triple dispatch (0x00537CE0); the concrete callback targets are provided by the caller and are not static.

compatibility_contracts.name: MpegHeaderDecodeFlow
compatibility_contracts.description: DecodeHeader (0x0052DC90) must read a 4-byte big-endian sync word through the I/O read slot at vtable+8 of *(this+0x2D34), pass the byte-swapped value to CMpegBase_ProcessHeader (0x0052DA30), treat processed frame sizes below 4 as corrupted, and re-arm the header-read flag at this+0x2D3C while clearing the frame-size field at this+0x24A8 on corruption recovery. A replacement executable must preserve this header/flag protocol and the waiting-for-CD / corrupted-header diagnostics.

compatibility_contracts.name: MpegIoInterfaceLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: The render object stores its I/O interface at this+0x2D34 and a secondary interface at this+0x2D38 (constructor 0x0052E170); the I/O interface's vtable must expose a 4-byte/byte-count read function at slot +8 relative to the vtable pointer. A replacement must preserve both slot locations and the +8 read slot.

compatibility_contracts.name: StreamDecoderAllocatorVtable
compatibility_contracts.description: The stream decoder (0x0051D166) reaches its allocator through the interface stored at this+0x4 and calls vtable entry 0 with (this, 1, 48) to allocate the decoder sub-struct and entry 1 to allocate the streaming buffer of size this+0x5C * this+0x64; mode flag this+0x110 == 2 selects the audio path. A replacement must keep the allocator interface at +0x4, the two vtable entry slots, and the mode value 2.

compatibility_contracts.name: DeflateBlockContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The DEFLATE family must preserve the inflate block format (stored LEN/NLEN, fixed and dynamic Huffman, code-length ordering table 0x005B7C60, mask table 0x005DBB90) with the BFINAL flag at this+0x18 driving the final block path, and the matching deflate bit writer must accumulate 3 bits per symbol call and flush a two-byte register past the 13-bit threshold (shift register this+0x16AB, bit count this+0x16AD, capacity this+0x16A7).

compatibility_contracts.name: LargeStructPartialResetPreservation
compatibility_contracts.description: The partial reset (0x00511F70) zeroes 0x19C bytes of the container while preserving the first 0x40 bytes and the dwords at +0x40/+0x44/+0x48, and releases six unconditional sub-resources plus two flag-gated resources (release flag byte at +0x5D, bits 0x10 and 0x20) and a counted pointer array (base +0x144, count 1 << (8 - byte +0x12C)). A replacement must preserve the preservation mask and the release gating.

compatibility_contracts.name: CodecStateCallbackContract
compatibility_contracts.description: StateResetWithCallback (0x00537000) dispatches state codes 4/5 through the caller's function pointer at a2+36 with (*(a2+40), a1[3]) and state 6 through vtable+0x24, then resets the state code to 0, restores the backup at this+0x28 into this+0x30, and re-registers the stored callback at a1[14] with (0,0,0) storing its result at a1[15] and a2+48.
